title: SQUALO - Sanlorenzo SL86
highlights: Enlarged side windows for panoramic views
Bow lounge with sofas, sunpads and table
Tender garage and hydraulic swim platform
description:
SQUALO is a Sanlorenzo SL86 designed with Officina Italiana Design to maximise space and natural light, with an amidship sheer line and enlarged side windows giving panoramic views from the salon. The bow is transformed into a lounge with sofas, sunpads, a table and an awning.

An expansive flybridge, a tender garage and a hydraulic swim platform complete her exterior spaces. She is lying in Fort Lauderdale, Florida.
